title: Official information in practice
intro: Keep and share classified documents correctly. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Draft budget
decisions.prompt: A colleague who does not work on the budget asks for it. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Draft budget
body: Hi! Could you forward me the draft budget from Finance? I just want to have a look.

decisions.explain: If there is a real need, a manager approves it the official way.

decisions.title: Message from Nərmin Hüseynova
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Nərmin Hüseynova
body: Hi, I am out of the office. Send the draft order to my WhatsApp, I will look at it here.

options.label: I will send it in SənədAxını

decisions.explain: The document stays in the official system and your manager can open it there.

decisions.title: Call from Ministry of Regional Relations

artifact.name: Ministry of Regional Relations
body: Hello, this is Samir Quliyev from the Ministry of Regional Relations. For a joint project we need your department's staff list with mobile numbers.

decisions.explain: Requests between institutions come as official letters and management answers.

decisions.title: Quarterly report
decisions.prompt: Can you fulfil this request or not?

artifact.subject: Quarterly report
body: Please send me the team's report through SənədAxını, we present it to the ministry tomorrow.

decisions.explain: Your manager works with this document and asks for the official system. This is normal work.

decisions.title: Message from Tural (HR)
decisions.prompt: Can you fulfil this request or not?

artifact.name: Tural (HR)
body: Hi! Send me the draft budget too, just curious whose salary goes up.

decisions.explain: Curiosity is not a need. If HR does not work with this document, do not send it.
